text:
Plumber in Rockingham checks where his Google Ads clicks come from.

Some are from Bunbury. He never works there.

Google can show your ads to people who only showed interest in your area.

In location settings, pick "Presence": people in or regularly in your area.

Roofer in Cannington tells me: "Our Google Ads got 900 clicks last month."

How many calls?

"No idea."

Then nobody knows if the ads made money.

Google Ads can count the calls your ads bring in. Switch call tracking on before you judge the ads.

Bathroom renovator in Wanneroo asks me: "What can you actually do for me?"

Two jobs.

Show up on Google when someone nearby searches.
Keep showing up on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram until they book.

If an agency can't explain its work in two sentences, don't hire it.
